Remove as many tiles as possible and earn the highest score. A win (“Complete”) means the board is entirely clear. “Dead end” means tiles remain but no group of two or more adjacent matching tiles is available; a dead end does not update the record.

Select a vertically or horizontally connected group of matching tiles. Click it again, or press Enter on an already selected group, to remove it. A single tile cannot be removed. Tiles fall after a move and empty columns slide left.
Removing N tiles scores (N - 2)^2 points. There is no additional board-clear bonus.

The whole game can be played with the cursor. Arrow keys move the keyboard cursor, and Enter selects a group or confirms removal. Space is an alternate select: on the selected group it clears selection, while on another group it selects that group. The Clear selection button always clears regardless of cursor position. Undo and Redo apply only to the current game.
Quick load and menu load reset the current game. Saved records remain. A best score is written separately only after the board is completely clear.

F5/F9 and menu loading preserve the exact active game during the current game process. The reward is fixed when an attempt starts and cannot be rerolled by loading. Easy gives no reward. A completed board cannot be replayed; New game creates a new attempt.
